title: office.scribe-pending request
description: Parse one session transcript through the conversation adapter (text between the user and the agent only, credentials scrubbed) into <library>/.office/state/scribe/<session_id>.jsonl (the Library's git-ignored state), owner-only, and return what the scribe has not read yet. Model-free; no Library commit. format v2 (or a session whose SCR is already v2) returns the v2 view instead: the typed-turn markers, the agent markers kept apart, the session scope and the scope's previous SCR.

transcript.description: Transcript path inside the granted workspace or Library.

provider.description: Transcript format; only claude-code has an adapter.

cwd.description: The session's working directory; used to derive the project name when no resolved project is provided.

project.description: Optional caller-resolved repository name used as the SCR project and default topic; absent, the project is derived from the cwd (a <repo>/.claude/worktrees/<name> cwd names <repo>, else the cwd basename).

custom_title.description: Optional latest customTitle from the transcript's custom-title records; when present it is the SCR slug and title source for any session.

format.description: v1 (default, unless the session already has a v2 SCR) or v2.

scope.description: v2 only: the session scope, global, project (the session's project) or project:<name>; absent, the session's project, else global. Fixed once the session's SCR exists.
